title: Add more analytics views (FRONTEND)
description:
Enhance the analytics dashboard with additional views and visualizations:

- Add task completion trends over time (daily, weekly, monthly)
- Implement project-wise performance metrics
- Create burndown charts for project progress tracking
- Add team productivity analytics with individual contributor metrics
- Implement task type distribution charts (bug, feature, enhancement)
- Add priority-based analytics showing high/medium/low priority task distribution
- Create time-to-completion analytics for different task types
- Implement comparative analytics between projects
- Add export functionality for analytics data (CSV, PDF)
- Create customizable dashboard widgets that users can arrange

title: Host the webpage in remote server
description:
Deploy TaskTrek application to a remote server for production use:

- Set up CI/CD pipeline for automated deployments
- Configure production build optimization (minification, bundling)
- Choose and configure hosting platform (AWS, Vercel, Netlify, or DigitalOcean)
- Set up domain name and SSL certificate for secure HTTPS access
- Configure environment variables for production settings
- Implement database hosting solution for persistent data storage
- Set up monitoring and logging for production environment
- Configure backup and disaster recovery procedures
- Implement load balancing if needed for scalability
- Set up staging environment for testing before production deployment
- Configure CDN for faster content delivery
- Implement security measures (firewall, rate limiting, CORS)

title: Add more animations
description:
Enhance user experience with smooth and engaging animations throughout the application:

- Implement page transition animations between different views
- Add loading animations for data fetching operations
- Create hover effects for interactive elements (buttons, cards, links)
- Implement smooth slide-in/slide-out animations for modals and sidebars
- Add progress animations for task completion status changes
- Create animated icons and micro-interactions for better feedback
- Implement smooth scrolling and parallax effects where appropriate
- Add fade-in animations for newly created tasks and projects
- Create animated charts and graphs in analytics views
- Implement drag-and-drop animations for task reordering
- Add skeleton loading screens for better perceived performance
- Create celebration animations for task completion
- Implement smooth expand/collapse animations for task details
- Add CSS transitions for theme switching (dark/light mode)

title: Send weekly reports
description:
Implement automated weekly reporting system to keep stakeholders informed:

- Create weekly report template with key metrics and insights
- Implement automated report generation with project progress summaries
- Add task completion statistics (completed, in-progress, overdue)
- Include team productivity metrics and individual contributor highlights
- Generate charts and visualizations for report data
- Implement email notification system for report distribution
- Create customizable report recipients list per project
- Add report scheduling functionality (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly options)
- Implement report history and archive functionality
- Create PDF export capability for reports
- Add executive summary section with key highlights and blockers
- Implement trend analysis comparing current week with previous weeks
- Add milestone tracking and upcoming deadline alerts
- Create customizable report templates for different stakeholder groups
- Implement report delivery confirmation and read receipts

title: Capability to configure AI chat bots within the task comments
description:
Integrate AI chatbot functionality directly into task comment system for enhanced collaboration:

- Implement AI chatbot integration (OpenAI GPT, Claude, or similar) within task comments
- Create configuration interface for AI bot settings (model selection, temperature, context)
- Add @bot mention functionality to trigger AI responses in comment threads
- Implement context-aware responses based on task details and project information
- Create AI bot personas for different use cases (code reviewer, project manager, QA tester)
- Add capability to configure different AI models per project or team
- Implement conversation history and context retention within task threads
- Create AI-powered task analysis and suggestion features
- Add automated code review capabilities when code snippets are shared
- Implement AI-powered task estimation and timeline suggestions
- Create smart notifications when AI detects potential issues or blockers
- Add AI-powered task categorization and labeling suggestions
- Implement privacy controls and data handling for AI interactions
- Create usage analytics and cost tracking for AI API calls
- Add fallback mechanisms when AI services are unavailable

title: Capability to generate AI comments
description:
Implement AI-powered comment generation to assist users with task documentation and communication:

- Create AI comment generation interface with customizable prompts and templates
- Implement context-aware comment suggestions based on task status and history
- Add AI-powered progress update generation for task status changes
- Create automated comment generation for code commits and pull requests
- Implement AI-generated meeting notes and action items from task discussions
- Add smart comment templates for different task types (bug reports, feature requests)
- Create AI-powered task summary generation for stakeholder updates
- Implement automated comment generation for milestone achievements
- Add AI-assisted comment translation for multi-language teams
- Create intelligent comment categorization and tagging
- Implement AI-powered comment sentiment analysis and tone suggestions
- Add automated follow-up comment generation for overdue tasks
- Create AI-generated test case comments and acceptance criteria
- Implement smart comment formatting and markdown generation
- Add AI-powered comment quality scoring and improvement suggestions
- Create batch comment generation for multiple tasks
- Implement AI-generated retrospective comments and lessons learned

title: Fit and finish UX
description:
Polish the user experience with comprehensive fit and finish improvements:

- Conduct comprehensive UX audit and identify pain points in user workflows
- Implement consistent design system with standardized colors, typography, and spacing
- Add responsive design improvements for mobile and tablet devices
- Create intuitive navigation with breadcrumbs and clear information hierarchy
- Implement accessibility improvements (WCAG 2.1 compliance, keyboard navigation, screen reader support)
- Add contextual help tooltips and onboarding tutorials for new users
- Implement smart search functionality with filters and auto-suggestions
- Create customizable user preferences and settings panel
- Add drag-and-drop functionality for task management and prioritization
- Implement bulk operations for task management (bulk edit, delete, assign)
- Create keyboard shortcuts for power users and improved productivity
- Add dark/light theme toggle with system preference detection
- Implement error handling with user-friendly error messages and recovery options
- Create loading states and skeleton screens for better perceived performance
- Add confirmation dialogs for destructive actions
- Implement undo/redo functionality for critical operations
- Create export/import functionality for data portability
- Add print-friendly views for reports and task lists

description: Resolve synchronization issues between MCP server and TaskTrek application. The sync issue was fixed by moving the common storage to the public directory.
